actions.name: create_follow_up
actions.description: Create a Ri task linked to an opportunity or interview, with an optional due date. The link and its operation ID are saved first, so retrying or clicking twice returns the same task. Nothing is sent to anyone.

Nothing is saved until apply_import. A link alone is kept as a link, never fetched.

actions.name: apply_import
actions.description: Save exactly what a preview showed, once. The preview ID and digest must match. A retry, or a second import of the same source, returns the records already saved instead of duplicates.

actions.name: list_imports
actions.description: List files the person imported: job descriptions, materials and opportunity files, with how many records each created.

actions.name: delete_import
actions.description: Delete what one imported file created, keeping anything the person has built on since: a description used by preparation, a submitted material, or an opportunity with its own history.

actions.name: list_sources
actions.description: List this app's sources: the two collections the person owns and each connected account, showing whether it is granted to this app, updated automatically, paused, its history range, coverage, last success, pending and failed steps and a redacted last error.

actions.name: set_source
actions.description: Change one account's setup: history range (30, 90 or 365 days), the calendars to read for interviews, or pause and resume updates.

actions.name: list_source_calendars
actions.description: List the calendars of one granted Google Calendar account so the person can choose which ones to read for interviews.

actions.name: preview_source
actions.description: Show up to ten recent application, recruiter, interview and offer emails from one granted mailbox, by subject and sender only, so the person can see what the app would import. Nothing is stored.

actions.name: continue_import
actions.description: Run one bounded import step for one account now, the same step the schedule runs: one provider page and at most ten new messages, or one small enrichment batch.

output.message: 8 messages read, 6 kept as job correspondence. More to read

actions.name: delete_source_data
actions.description: Delete everything imported from one account: messages, cached bodies, interviews from its calendar, stage changes it caused and its review items. Opportunities, notes, preparation and materials the person wrote are kept. Disconnecting the account is done in Ri.

actions.name: run_background_step
actions.description: The schedule's entry point: recover interrupted steps, then run one bounded sync or enrichment step for one of the automatically updated accounts, rotating fairly between accounts and kinds of work.

output.message: 8 messages read, 6 kept as job correspondence. More to read

actions.name: sync_step
actions.description: Run one bounded mail or calendar sync step for an automatically updated account: one provider page and at most ten new message bodies, committed with its checkpoint.

output.message: 8 messages read, 6 kept as job correspondence. More to read

actions.name: enrich_step
actions.description: Run one bounded AI enrichment batch: read up to three job emails the rules could not classify. AI readings only ever produce suggestions, never stage changes.

actions.name: create_scope
actions.description: Create the record access one chat or agent may use in this app: chosen collections and accounts, read or read and write. Ri saves it only when the person confirms the grant.
